prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: standalone transparent 512px square battle cutout for an original woodland card battler, judged at 13 × 13 CSS pixels and 26 × 26 CSS pixels
Input images: Image 1 is the V1 Kilnkeeper cutout edit target; keep the same badger identity and launcher concept while simplifying its shapes aggressively. Image 2 is the approved Kilnkeeper portrait identity reference; preserve its charcoal-and-cream badger markings, friendly focused face, teal work apron, and copper/rootwood emberseed launcher.
Primary request: Redraw the existing full-body Kilnkeeper as a compact chibi-like game unit whose silhouette and three color cues remain clearly separated when the complete 512px square is rendered at 13px tall.
Subject and proportions: One stout woodland badger kiln-worker. Make the oversized head about 45% of the figure height, with a broad cream face, two bold charcoal eye-mask patches and tiny dark eyes. Make the simple broad torso and teal apron about 30% of the figure height as a solid, unmistakable teal color block. Keep two short separated legs and chunky feet planted at the very bottom. Show the whole figure.
Pose and weapon: Front three-quarter stance. Hold a short, chunky copper-and-rootwood emberseed launcher across the lower torso, positioned clearly to the viewer's right of the white face. Its oversized round orange firing mouth faces forward and slightly downward. Leave a clearly visible dark contour or transparent gap between the muzzle and the cream face so those silhouettes cannot merge at 13px. Keep a single bright orange emberseed inside the mouth. Make the weapon a separate broad shape with a readable copper body and dark outline.
Style and rendering: Simplify to bold, clean, high-contrast color blocks with a thick dark contour and only a few broad shadow planes. Use minimal details; omit fine fur strands, stitches, apron patches, etched metal, tiny mechanisms, and delicate textures. Warm copper and orange, teal apron, cream face, charcoal mask. Keep the character friendly and polished as a stylized game illustration, but use chunky graphic forms rather than realistic painterly detail.
Composition: Center the complete compact figure in the square with minimal transparent padding, keeping ears, weapon mouth, and both feet inside the frame. Do not enlarge the unit beyond the 13px readability target or crop its feet. Use no ground plane or scenery.
Constraints: Preserve Kilnkeeper's original badger identity, teal apron, copper/rootwood launcher, full-body pose, and genuinely transparent background. Distinguish face, apron, and launcher as separate large color regions at 13 × 13 native CSS pixels. No motion, extra sparks, frame, text, label, logo, watermark, UI, or card border.
Avoid: Tiny detailed fur, complex highlights, photographic fur, realistic rendering, merged face and muzzle, tiny weapon mouth, hidden apron, extra characters, missing feet, copied commercial-game art or character design.
